ask: My brother says never to go and see a bike without knowing the seller's rock-bottom price. Can you tell me yours so I can show him?
text:
Hi, fair point from your brother, nobody wants a wasted trip! I hold off naming a rock-bottom price sight unseen, only because online lowest prices tend to turn into the new starting point on the doorstep.

So you've got the full picture to show him: it's a 2021 Trek FX 3 Disc hybrid (size M), serviced in March with new tyres put on in June. Full disclosure, the saddle has a small tear and the gears are a bit clunky when it's cold.

Factoring those couple of bits in, I've definitely got room to move on the £450 for a straightforward sale. Let me know what sort of figure you and your brother had in mind and I'll tell you straight away if we're in the right ballpark before you head over.

text:
